headline: Seventeen holds as the night settles.
body: The hour rests at seventeen degrees under a partly cloudy sky. Southwest wind runs near twelve kilometres an hour, pressure steady at one thousand nineteen. Dry paving and continuous evening traffic; the lamps have taken the streets.

pulses.label: Sky
pulses.value: partly cloudy, 17°C, SW 12 km/h, 1019 hPa steady
